historical_reviews.deepseek: A literal range operand cannot prove five fan resources or their physical positions, and the GPU-temperature oracle is unrelated.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The F suffix must be resolved from the vendor topology—presumptively one side of a dual-rotor or front/rear pair—not guessed as airflow direction or display order. Each numbered F member must bind to its chassis fan assembly and partner.

original_test_intent: Verify all expected UPPER_FAN1 through UPPER_FAN5 F-position resources in BMC Web, including physical assembly/position, RPM, units, health, thresholds, freshness and range against the approved cooling SPEC.
original_method: Establish fan population and vendor F/R semantics; enumerate five explicit F members in the protected UI; capture filter/pagination/refresh state; bind each to a chassis assembly and paired R member; compare complete fields to the SPEC; optionally correlate full backend data; preserve logs and make no fan-policy changes.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer resolves F-position semantics, confirms the five physical fan mappings and validates complete rendered evidence against the approved cooling SPEC.
required_inputs: Fan assembly, position and pair map
safety_requirements: Do not change fan duty/curves, cooling, power or firmware
agent_execution_scope: Map each to chassis assembly and R partner
Compare RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range
engineer_actions: Approve F/R semantics and fan map
Resolve missing, duplicate, stale or ambiguous positions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal `UPPER_FAN1~5_F` query does not enumerate five resources; truncated SDR and GPU-module expected output cannot prove this case.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture five explicit UI members and physical mappings; use untruncated exact-name backend reads only as approved corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Web/SPEC check and 3/3-minute estimate remain; generic clear and GPU-temperature substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the vendor fan map to bind every numbered F resource to a physical assembly, chassis position and R partner before judging speed/status.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds suffix semantics, pair relationship and deterministic completeness.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Five plausible RPM readings can still be misordered, duplicated or assigned to the wrong rotor side.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: F may mean front, forward or another vendor-defined channel; only the approved platform map may resolve it.

project_override_considerations: Define F/R semantics, five expected assemblies and pair mapping. The next R-position case and duplicate GPU-temperature row are independent; backend-only substitution needs approved UI equivalence.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/Web route and fan topology with F/R definition
Protected UI captures for all expected F members and page context
Per-member assembly/position/pair, RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion target upper F-position fans consistently. Generic clear and GPU-temperature output are method/reference defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fan map, suffix semantics, SPEC and UI are normal package inputs; execution becomes BLOCKED if F identity remains unresolved after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Prevents literal-range, display-order or GPU-temperature evidence from passing a position-specific five-fan Web check.
independent_technical_reasoning: Dual-rotor fan assemblies can report two independently failing tachometers even when airflow appears normal. The F channel therefore needs an explicit assembly and partner association; speed plausibility without suffix semantics cannot detect a swapped or duplicated tach mapping.
